scripts.name: hc
scripts.text:
#!/bin/bash
set -e
DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
# comment
hc run --name lead --cwd /w/app --label x=y -- claude --model opus "Plan the work"
hc run --name builder-1 --cwd /w/app/wt/one --parent lead -- codex exec "Build it"
hc run --name reviewer --cwd /w/app/wt/two --parent lead --on foo -- claude --permission-mode plan
hc run --name shell --cwd /w/app -- bash
herdr agent start dev --kind claude --pane 3 -- --model sonnet
herdr agent start other --kind gemini -- x

notes.text: 1 agent ran a CLI Assieme doesn't start yet (gemini), so they are left out.
1 agent ran once (codex exec) and stopped. Here they stay running and wait for work.
1 agent worked on their own branch. Here each gets a fresh branch of the project; the old branches stay as they are.
No brief was found for 3 agents, so they get the standard brief for their role. Check it before you start.

if true; then hc run --name c --cwd /w/z -- claude; fi
echo "hc run --name no --cwd /w -- claude"
